# Volunteer at CWB

The Center for Wooden Boats has been powered by volunteers since 1977. Today more than 400 volunteers contribute regularly to hands-on learning and access to the water.

## Why Volunteer at CWB?

- Earn one hour of boat use for every three hours volunteered
- Log 45 hours within 12 consecutive months to receive a free membership and free SailNOW! enrollment
- Rowing socials during boating season
- Volunteer appreciation events
- Monthly Community Nights
- Volunteer newsletter
- Service awards

### Volunteer opportunities

- Visitor Services
- Livery
- Boatshop
- Public Sail
- Sailing Instruction
- Boat Steward
- Toy Boat Builds
- Special Events
- Office Assistance
- Special Skills

## Join a Committee

Long-term volunteers interested in planning and behind-the-scenes work can join:

- Development/Grant Writing Team
- Sail Repair Team
- Collections Crew
- Women On the Water (WOW) Committee
- Photographers

## BECOME A VOLUNTEER (AGES 16+)

Volunteers must be 16 or older and pass a background check. Volunteer orientations are held the 2nd Saturday of each month at the South Lake Union campus. Please complete the online volunteer application before attending an orientation.

## QUESTIONS?

Email [volunteer@cwb.org](mailto:volunteer@cwb.org)
